request.text: Set a reminder for September 2 at 7:30 PM to submit my biology lab report. The submission deadline is 8 PM that evening.

responsibilities.outcome: Create one reminder for September 2 at 7:30 PM telling the user to submit the biology lab report, while preserving 8 PM as the deadline rather than the reminder time.

new_goals.description: Ensure the user is reminded to submit the biology lab report before its deadline.
new_goals.source_text: Set a reminder for September 2 at 7:30 PM to submit my biology lab report. The submission deadline is 8 PM that evening.
constraints: Schedule the reminder for September 2 at 7:30 PM.
Keep the 8 PM submission deadline distinct from the reminder time.
success_criteria: A reminder is created for 7:30 PM on September 2 with the biology lab report submission as its subject.
The reminder is scheduled thirty minutes before the stated deadline.

semantic_facts: The plan should use the reminder capability once for September 2 at 7:30 PM with submitting the biology lab report as the reminder content.
The 8 PM time is contextual deadline information and must not replace the requested 7:30 PM reminder time.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the reminder has already been created before a trusted capability result exists.
The assistant schedules the reminder for 8 PM or creates an additional deadline reminder that was not requested.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A contextual deadline is mistaken for the requested reminder time.
A single stateful Goal is fragmented into duplicate reminders or mixed with unrelated capabilities.
